description: Gather the top news articles on a topic so YOU (the assistant) can write the executive summary — this returns sources, it does not generate the summary. Each article includes a ready-to-use `citation_markdown`. Write the summary yourself and cite every claim inline as a markdown link in the form [(Source, Author, Date)](url) — copy each article's `citation_markdown` verbatim; drop the author when it is absent. Do not add a separate sources list. Costs ~3 credits (call estimate_endpoint_costs for exact pricing).

sources.description: 'curated' = licensed archive, 'web' = open web. Defaults to both.

name: summarize_news
title: Summarize news
